extDescription.message: Summarize pages and selected text with your own local or remote LLM (Ollama, OpenAI-compatible). No account, no tracking.

errCantRead.message: Can't read this page (chrome:// pages, the Web Store and the PDF viewer can't be read).

noAccess.message: No permission to read this tab. Click the extension icon (or press Alt+S) and the page will be read and summarized.

pickModel.message: Choose a model in Settings first.

longText.message: The text is long; processing the first part…

doneCut.message: Done (only the first part of the long text was summarized).

unreachable.message: Can't reach the server. Check the address and permission in Settings.

urlHint.message: Example: https://llm.example.com or a VPN address such as Tailscale. Don't expose Ollama directly to the internet.

supportText.message: Free and ad-free. If it helps you, you can support it voluntarily; no feature depends on it.

privacyHint.message: Page content is sent only to the server you enter above. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

badUrl.message: Enter a valid address (it must start with http:// or https://).

noPermission.message: Access to this address was not granted.

foundPick.message: $COUNT$ models found. Pick one and press Save.

unreachableOpt.message: Can't reach the server. Check the address, network and HTTPS/certificate.

presetFilled.message: Address filled in. Paste your API key, then press Load models.

presetFilledNoKey.message: Address filled in. No key needed; press Load models.

err401.message: Unauthorized (401): the API key is wrong or missing.

err403.message: Access denied (403): check the key, region or server settings.

err404.message: Not found (404): the address or model name may be wrong.

err429.message: Rate limit reached (429): wait a bit or try another model or provider.
